params.name: site
params.description: It refers to the country code and must be filled with two alphabetic characters.

params.name: language
params.description: This field must be filled with the language in which you want to receive the response.

params.name: from
params.description: Start date of the search range. This field must be used together with 'to'; providing only one of the two parameters is not supported.

params.name: to
params.description: End date of the search range. This field must be used together with 'from'; providing only one of the two parameters is not supported.
